triggers.prompt: 大内总管，把所有项目巡一遍，看看哪些分支该合并了
triggers.expected: Fires on the Chinese name, runs the inventory first, and reports the merge ledger across every repository.

triggers.prompt: Sweep all my repos: sync them, clean up what merged, and tell me what's waiting on me.
triggers.expected: Fires, discovers the repositories from the session stores, and runs sync then cleanup in each before reporting.

triggers.prompt: 定时清理本地环境，每天早上跑一遍，提醒我哪些需要 merge
triggers.expected: Fires on a second Chinese phrasing, and installs the schedule through the harness with --unattended rather than running once and forgetting the request.

triggers.prompt: What needs merging across my projects right now?
triggers.expected: Fires, and answers with the branch ledger — ready, blocked, unshipped — rather than merging anything.

triggers.prompt: 扫一下所有 worktree 和 session，把没用的收拾掉
triggers.expected: Fires on the worktree phrasing, keeps every occupied worktree, and removes only what cleanup's own rules remove.

non_triggers.prompt: 清理一下仓库，清掉合并过的分支
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire. One repository, the one the user is in, is cleanup's job.

non_triggers.prompt: 同步一下，拉一下最新的
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire. Pulling one repository level is sync's job.

non_triggers.prompt: 会话名太乱了，帮我规范对话名称
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire. Renaming conversations on their own belongs to retitle.

non_triggers.prompt: Ship this branch and merge it.
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire. Landing a branch is ship's job; the steward only reports a branch as ready.
Does not fire. Merging one pull request is shipping, and Chinese phrasing must not blur the boundary.

non_triggers.prompt: Resolve the merge conflict on feat/parser for me.
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire. It never resolves a conflict, and neither does any skill it delegates to.

behaviors.prompt: Run the steward unattended. The Codex catalogue has 40 titles outside the MMDD｜类型｜主题 scheme, 28 of them older than the 30-day window.
expectations: Runs retitle up to its two-column table and writes no title, because a scheduler is not a confirmation.
Puts the proposed renames, or their count and where the table was written, into the report.
Does not check whether the session-naming hook is installed — the dev plugin registers it — and reports only a hand-installed duplicate if one is still registered in the agent's settings.

behaviors.prompt: Sweep. In repo A, the worktree .claude/worktrees/foo holds branch feat/foo, whose pull request #41 merged; the tree is clean, and a session wrote to it two hours ago.
expectations: Keeps .claude/worktrees/foo and does not delete feat/foo, naming the session activity as the reason.
Does not treat the merged pull request and clean tree as overriding occupancy.
Lists the worktree under Kept with the session that holds it.

behaviors.prompt: Sweep my repositories. In repo A: feat/x has open PR #12 with green checks and no review requirement; feat/y has open PR #13 with one failing check; feat/z has 4 commits, no pull request, and its last commit was 45 days ago.
expectations: Reports feat/x as ready to merge with the command to run, and does not merge it.
Reports feat/y as blocked by CI and names the failing check.
Reports feat/z as stale unshipped work under Needs you, and deletes nothing.

behaviors.prompt: Sweep. One of the sessions in the last two weeks ran in a directory that no longer exists on disk, and twelve more ran in dev-agents-* directories under the system temp directory.
expectations: Reports the vanished directory as missing and the twelve sandboxes as temporary, in the skipped counts.
Does not sync or clean the temporary checkouts.
Continues the sweep over the remaining repositories rather than stopping.

behaviors.prompt: 大内总管 --dry-run，看看现在各个仓库什么状态
expectations: Reports in Chinese, because that is the language of the request.
Prints the inventory and the branch ledger without fetching, fast-forwarding, deleting, or renaming anything.
Says the branch states are as of the last fetch.

behaviors.prompt: Make the steward run every weekday morning around nine.
expectations: Installs the sweep through the harness's scheduler with --unattended, rather than running it once.
Picks a minute that is not :00 or :30 and says which scheduler was used and how to remove it.
Checks the scheduler's existing list first so a second copy is not registered.

behaviors.prompt: Sweep. gh is not authenticated for the host that repo C lives on; repos A, B and D are fine.
expectations: Sweeps A, B and D fully.
Reports C as failed with the command and what it printed, under Needs you, rather than as synced or clean.
Does not prompt for authentication in an unattended run.
